Tess (CS): Heads-up: BrightLeaf onboarding call tomorrow 9:30am PT. Account health = borderline (trial active, sporadic spikes, renewal ~36 days). They reported long cold-start latencies after idle and a couple of 5xxs. Need a very small customer-facing playbook we can send (prep steps + one-click feedback capture). Who can own post-call follow-up?

Marco (Eng): Lite plan: 1) delta prefetch top-5 prompts, 2) adaptive batching with target latency 22-28ms and max batch 12, 3) streaming enabled with small chunk fallback (256). Suggest synthetic prefill 20-30m before with 30 concurrent traces to warm KV and kernels. Shareable warmup snippet: 
```bash
# synthetic prefill (30 parallel)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/brightleaf-prod/warmup \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"prompt":"<sample>"}' &
done; wait
```

Jade (SRE): SRE constraints: route timeout 6s, circuit breaker at 4% errors over 2m, slow-start cap 120rps for first 10m. Add alert: `redwood_route_error_rate{route=\"brightleaf-prod\"} > 4% for 2m`. Also monitor p50/p95 token latency: alert if p95 > 900ms for 3m. I'll wire a temporary pager during the call window.

Felix (PM): I'll own the customer checklist and feedback capture. Post-call we do a 3-question micro-survey (latency ok? quality ok? blockers?) and a single-click CS sentiment: thumbs-up / thumbs-down. I'll push a CRM tag if thumbs-down.

Tess (CS): Can PrefillBot schedule the prefill and capture KV cache hit-rate samples plus first-token latency before/after so we can show the delta live in-call? Also want an ops-safe fallback: if p95>1s flip to lite-model.

PrefillBot: Prefill job scheduled by Marco: id=pb-1945678901 run_at=2026-11-03T09:00:00Z concurrency=30 route=brightleaf-prod. Logs & metrics: /warmups/pb-1945678901 (includes kv_hits and first_token_samples). :white_check_mark:

Marco (Eng): For private deploys recommend KV cache 700MB when customer has many short-context prompts; use int8 quantized variant if QA tolerates. For hosted, pick reserved L4x profile for burst stability. Also set prefix_cache_TTL=10m and adaptive_decay=0.8 to avoid stale prefix thrash.

Jade (SRE): I'll add Prometheus snippet to the runbook and an automation step: if p95>1000ms -> switch route to `brightleaf-prod-lite` and notify CS. Prom query to add: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_route_latency_bucket{route=\"brightleaf-prod\"}[3m])) by (le)) > 0.9`.

Felix (PM): Action items recap: Marco schedules prefill & posts final script, Jade wires alerts + temporary pager, I build micro-survey + CRM hookup, Tess sends the concise customer-facing checklist 30m before the call and runs the preflight.

Tess (CS): Quick customer checklist I'll send: 1) confirm API key + route, 2) enable streaming & small-chunk fallback, 3) accept 30m warmup window, 4) run smoke prompt samples on call, 5) post-call micro-survey link. Keep it one page.

Marco (Eng): I'll also post a tiny diagnostic command customers can run if they see hiccups: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/brightleaf-prod/diagnose \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"check":["kv_hit_rate","first_token_latency"]}'
```

Jade (SRE): During the call window I'll watch errors and token latency. Pager policy: escalate if errors>6% for 1m or p95>1200ms for 2m.

PrefillBot: Warmup completed: pb-1945678901 - kv_hit_rate pre=0.02 post=0.78, first_token p50 pre=980ms post=180ms. Artifacts: /warmups/pb-1945678901/results.json :rocket:

Tess (CS): Nice — we'll show that graph live. I'll ping when checklist sent. Thanks team!

Felix (PM): I'll prepare the micro-survey and the one-click CS sentiment link and post here after the call so we can tag renewal if needed.

Marco (Eng): One more note — for customers with variable prompt mixes suggest enabling per-prompt cache profiling so we only prefetch heavy hitters. I'll add a short note to the checklist.

Tess (CS): Great, that should keep the call tight. See ya all tomorrow.
